_doc: tools/import_hug_guns.gd reads this: every <kind>_<tier>.png here (the gun alone, horizontal, muzzle RIGHT, no hand grips, flat green backdrop) → assets/weapons/<kind>/hug_<tier>.png + assets/weapons/hug.json. length: world px long in the match (57: about 1.5 × Rookie's kneeling body width); per gun (guns.<kind>_<tier>) length, hold [x, y], muzzle [x, y] (source px) background (key options over the shared ones) and despill (true: no key colour left anywhere, for art with none) may be set; a gun with no picture is made from another tier's: from (the tier) + recolour (tools/import_guns.gd recolour(): saturation / value multipliers, hue shift in degrees, hueRange [lo, hi] limits it to those hues). See the tool's header and assets/README.md.

icons._doc: the equipment icons cut from the hug art (size / margin / tiltDeg: the held guns' art_source/weapons/guns_v1.json icons unless set here): <name with <tier>>.png in assets/icons/equipment/, one scale per group

bazooka_dragon._doc: a shaded 22 px sliver of backdrop between the collar and the head, enclosed by the outline: keyed as a hole, no green left (the dragon has no green)

bazooka_basic._doc: the starter bazooka: the iron one desaturated, guns_v1.json recolours.basic (old basic.png = iron.png × that)

bazooka_steel._doc: the olive of the old steel.png vs iron.png fitted on matching pixels (hue -4.5°, saturation ×1.25, value ×0.975; the red warhead unchanged)
